title: Energy Carrier Map
summary: Hydrogen carries energy from renewables to trucks, ships, and industry.
coachPrompt: Follow the path Sun → Electricity → Hydrogen, then deliver H₂ energy to transport, shipping, and industry.

destinations.label: Maritime
destinations.description: Cargo ships using H₂ as fuel

teachingPoints: Hydrogen stores and moves energy made from the sun and renewables.
That is why hydrogen is called an energy carrier.
